Covariate balance from the implicit weights of AIPW or regression adjustment

Source: R/twfeweights_mp.R
aipw_cov_bal.Rd

Computes how well the implicit weights from implicit_aipw_weights() balance covariates between each treated group and the never-treated group, for each post-treatment \((g,t)\) cell. As in twfe_cov_bal(), each covariate is averaged over time within each unit first, so the results can be compared with those for TWFE.

Usage

aipw_cov_bal(decomposed_aipw, extra_balance_vars_formula)

Arguments

decomposed_aipw

A decomposed_aipw object from implicit_aipw_weights().

extra_balance_vars_formula

One-sided formula for the covariates to report balance for, e.g. ~ x1 + x2 + region. They do not need to be in the TWFE regression.

Value

The decomposed_aipw object with a balance table cov_bal_df added to each element of aipw_gt.

Examples

data(castle, package = "causaldata")
castle <- as.data.frame(castle)
castle$G <- BMisc::get_group(castle, "sid", tname = "year", treatname = "post")
ra <- implicit_aipw_weights(
  yname = "l_homicide", tname = "year", idname = "sid", gname = "G",
  xformula = ~l_police, pscore_formula = ~1, data = castle
)
